name: us-trucking-company-leads
title: US Trucking Company Leads: New Carriers and Contacts
description: Newly registered US trucking companies from the FMCSA census, with phone, email, named officer, fleet size and address. Roughly 390 new active carriers a day, most of them one to three trucks. Keyless and updated daily. Filter by state, fleet size and operation type, or look up any carrier by DOT number.
